head: ReceiptLocker scans receipts and sorts them by tax category on your iPhone
dek: ReceiptLocker reads the vendor, total and date from a receipt photo on your iPhone and files it in a category that follows the US Schedule C tax form. It was #41 among paid Business apps on the US App Store on 10 November.
details: It's made for one-person businesses such as contractors, salons and freelancers. The photo isn't sent anywhere to be read. It shows totals per year and quarter and makes a PDF pack for your accountant. It costs $1.99 with no in-app purchases, by Brian Montenegro, and needs iOS 18.
means: If you're self-employed in the US, your receipts can be ready for tax time without a subscription.
todo: Find ReceiptLocker in the App Store.
